# Tiingo fixtures (SHAPE UNVERIFIED)

Built from Tiingo's public end-of-day documentation with synthetic values and the made-up symbol
TEST_TNGO. No real vendor data may be committed here: Tiingo data is licensed, and committing it
could count as redistribution. Before relying on the adapter, make one request per endpoint with
a personal key, compare the field names and types with these files, and record the result in
docs/DATA_SOURCES.md (without committing the response itself).
